FULL TEXT:
Walk-In-Interview
for project staff under Lead Knowledge Institution (LKI) of State Support Mission,
Chandigarh at Panjab University, Chandigarh
Panjab University, Chandigarh as a Lead Knowledge Institution (LKI) of State Support Mission,
Chandigarh for FY 2025-26 is inviting the interested eligible candidates to appear for Walk in
Interview for different temporary posts as mentioned against each Project in different theme area in
the attached Annexures. Eligibility Qualifications, Job Description and corresponding Emoluments
are mentioned against each Project Position in attached Annexures.
S.No. Theme Name PI Details of Post
1 Healthcare Prof. Rajat Sandhir Annexure - I
Reporting Date and Time: 30 November, 2026 at 11.00 AM
Reporting Venue: PI-RAHI Foundation, Technology Block, South Campus, Panjab University,
Sector 25, Chandigarh
Application Procedure
• All interested candidates may appear for Walk-In-Interview as per the Reporting time at the
reporting Venue mentioned above, along with the duly filled application form available below.
• Incomplete application forms and applications that are not in proper format may be summarily
rejected.
• Candidates should ensure that the information mentioned in the application form is accurate.
Once the
• application form is submitted no further request regarding any changes/ information in the
application form will be considered.
• The duly filled application form must be submitted at the time of reporting by 11:00 AM on
12.10.2026.
• The candidates must ascertain their eligibility before applying for different positions, as
ineligible candidates will not be interviewed.
• All the candidates are requested to appear for a walk-in interview with the application form,
experience certificates, publications and original degree certificates and transcripts.
• No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.
• Canvassing in any form or bringing influence, political or otherwise, will disqualify the
candidate(s).
Posts are purely on temporary basis and co-terminus with the term period of the project.
Prof. Rajat Sandhir
Project Investigator
